goal: Bring Chu-kei Insight to production graduation as a broad-coverage medium-term-plan discovery product. Company-count coverage across the intended listed-company universe takes priority over deep-detail completeness for a small subset. Continue expanding reliable primary-source coverage, normalizing plan-detection state, aligning canonical data with the public product, and hardening the repeatable ingestion/quality pipeline until the service is operationally complete. Continue autonomously from the current repository state and do not stop at an intermediate milestone while safe executable work remains. Graduation criteria: [1] The intended company universe is represented in the canonical coverage model and remaining unknown/not-checked states are minimized or explicitly justified; company-count coverage is prioritized over unnecessary deep-detail enrichment. [2] Plan Detection uses official or first-party evidence with preserved company/source/document identity, publication date, plan/version/period/fiscal semantics, currentness boundaries, and provenance; missing evidence is never converted into an inferred no-plan conclusion. [3] Canonical repository data and the public Chu-kei product are aligned so production reflects the current broad company universe rather than an obsolete smaller snapshot, with core search/browse/detail behavior functioning against the aligned dataset. [4] Ingestion, candidate generation, validation, quality review, and production-alignment workflows are bounded, resumable, repeatable, and no known deterministic pipeline blocker remains; repository CI and production smoke/runtime checks are green. [5] All machine-resolvable quality gaps required for public reliability are closed. Any genuinely human-only review or externally consequential publication boundary remains explicit and is never silently auto-approved. Keep CI, validation, provenance, quota limits, and existing human-only safety boundaries intact. Only when every graduation criterion is demonstrably satisfied and final repository/runtime checks are green, create or update docs/ADE_COMPLETION.json as JSON with schema_version=1 and status=COMPLETE plus concise evidence fields. If the marker does not yet qualify, choose the highest-value bounded work that moves the project toward graduation. When creating a not-yet-existing file, declare its exact path in new_paths.
